title: Delete Part deletes the part at once with no confirmation
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-DELETE-01) is stocked at {Location-A} and is on no work order, return or credit.
custom_steps:
1. Type {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Click Delete Part.
  4. Type {Part-A} in the search on the Active tab.
  5. Click the Inactive tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the window closes straight away; no confirmation is asked.
  • Step 4: no row on the Active tab.
  • Step 5: no row on the Inactive tab.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-R26, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 2.1 (The part as it stands), 13 Oct copy.
